examples.question: greige summary
examples.sql: SELECT SUM(METER) as 'Greige Total Meters', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Greige Total PKR', COUNT(*) as 'Greige Count' FROM GreigeData
examples.description: Summary of greige data with total meters, amount, and record count

examples.question: yarn summary
examples.sql: SELECT SUM(LBS) as 'Yarn Total LBS', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Yarn Total PKR', COUNT(*) as 'Yarn Count' FROM YarnData
examples.description: Summary of yarn data with total weight in LBS, amount, and record count

examples.question: top suppliers greige
examples.sql: SELECT TOP 5 SUPPLIER, SUM(METER) as 'Total Meters', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Total PKR' FROM GreigeData GROUP BY SUPPLIER ORDER BY SUM(METER) DESC
examples.description: Top 5 suppliers by total meters in greige data

examples.question: top suppliers yarn
examples.sql: SELECT TOP 5 SUPPLIER, SUM(LBS) as 'Total LBS', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Total PKR' FROM YarnData GROUP BY SUPPLIER ORDER BY SUM(LBS) DESC
examples.description: Top 5 suppliers by total LBS in yarn data

examples.question: supplier top 5 greige
examples.sql: SELECT TOP 5 SUPPLIER, SUM(METER) as 'Total Meters', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Total PKR' FROM GreigeData GROUP BY SUPPLIER ORDER BY SUM(METER) DESC

examples.question: supplier top 5 yarn
examples.sql: SELECT TOP 5 SUPPLIER, SUM(LBS) as 'Total LBS', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Total PKR' FROM YarnData GROUP BY SUPPLIER ORDER BY SUM(LBS) DESC

examples.question: Top suppliers by ARRIVAL (incoming stock)
examples.sql: SELECT TOP 5 SUPPLIER, SUM(METER) as 'Total Meters', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Total PKR' FROM GreigeData WHERE MOVEMENT = 'ARRIVAL' GROUP BY SUPPLIER ORDER BY SUM(METER) DESC
examples.description: Top suppliers by arrival movement in greige data

examples.question: Top suppliers by ARRIVAL (incoming stock)
examples.sql: SELECT TOP 5 SUPPLIER, SUM(LBS) as 'Total LBS', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Total PKR' FROM YarnData WHERE MOVEMENT = 'ARRIVAL' GROUP BY SUPPLIER ORDER BY SUM(LBS) DESC
examples.description: Top suppliers by arrival movement in yarn data

examples.question: total yarn movement
examples.sql: SELECT MOVEMENT, SUM(LBS) as 'Total LBS', SUM(AMOUNT) as 'Total PKR', COUNT(*) as 'Count' FROM YarnData GROUP BY MOVEMENT ORDER BY SUM(LBS) DESC
examples.description: Total yarn by movement type showing LBS, PKR, and count
